rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for something that blocks progress or makes an activity harder.

example.english: The heavy rain became a hindrance to the project's progress.
example.traditional: 呢場大雨成為工程進度嘅障礙。
example.jyutping: ne1 coeng4 daai6 jyu5 sing4 wai4 gung1 cing4 zeon3 dou6 ge3 zoeng3 ngoi6

rows.note: Use this when the hindrance is framed as trouble or inconvenience caused to someone, rather than as a physical or abstract obstacle.

example.english: Having to go back to the office specially to get the forgotten documents was a real hindrance.
example.traditional: 要我特登返公司攞漏咗嘅文件，真係麻煩。
example.jyutping: jiu3 ngo5 dak6 dang1 faan2 gung1 si1 lo2 lau6 zo2 ge3 man4 gin6 zan1 hai6 maa4 faan4
